title: TitaniumPack
description: Replace Netherite with Titanium and make mining in the Nether easier!
body:
![Titaniumpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90936b6375980959c736972f98b28e21941b604d_0.webp)

Tired of hunting for Ancient Debris? Replace Netherite with Titanium and revolutionize your Nether mining experience!

This pack introduces a fully fleshed-out Titanium suite, from raw ore and ingots to decorative blocks and complete tool and armor sets. Designed as a more accessible alternative to Netherite, Titanium is easier to find while exploring the depths of the Nether.

Featuring exclusive advancements and the powerful Runic Plate for upgrades, this pack doesn't just add items—it adds a new layer of progression. Give your world a sleek, metallic makeover with a practical twist and discover new building possibilities today!
